evaluation_rows: validation (target Sundays 2026-01-04 .. 2026-06-28), eligible_d41 at the origin; identical rows for learned and persistence

features.log1p_n_weeks_history: log1p(number of observed weeks up to and including the origin week)
features.log_y_origin: log(y_origin): origin-week median modal (Phase 8 anchor, log scale as in design_matrix)
features.month_sin: sin(2*pi*(month-1)/12), month of the origin week Thursday (Phase 8 calendar convention)
features.r_lag1: lag1 / y_origin: median of the week before the origin week; NaN if that week has no cell
features.r_lag2: lag2 / y_origin: two weeks before; NaN if absent
features.r_lag4: lag4 / y_origin: four weeks before; NaN if absent
features.r_lag52: lag52 / y_origin: 52 weeks before the ORIGIN week; NaN if absent (all series before 2025-02)
features.weeks_since_prev_obs: weeks between the origin week and the series previous observed week; NaN for the first week

selection_rule: per crop: eligible for further consideration only if MAE(learned) < MAE(persistence) in 2026Q1 AND in 2026Q2, AND the market-clustered 95% CI of skill vs persistence is entirely above 0 in each quarter; identical eligible rows; 10000 replicates, seed 20261022; fixed before any training, never relaxed
target: log(y_target / y_origin); prediction = y_origin * exp(model output) (Phase 8 log_ratio)
training_rule: at refit T: all examples with target Sunday <= T whose series reached D-41 eligibility at an origin Sunday <= T, including that series earlier weeks (Phase 8 training_examples, eligible_by_refit)
